sourceContext: Costa Clean / implementación v2 / workstream implementacion-v2 / continue current implementation after N5.2 CLOSED/PASS_QA. Reuse existing Codex thread Implementar v3 if the local orchestrator binding still proves that identity; otherwise fail closed.
objective: Implement N5.3 normalization and validation foundation locally from exact application baseline eb4b3708c0adc56f936b067460bdc42814d33751, using deterministic provider-independent TypeScript logic, comprehensive tests and documentation, then continue autonomously through safe local verification until the next genuine human-approval gate.
why: N5.1 is closed and N5.2 is CLOSED/PASS_QA. The next pending implementation work is N5.3, which must normalize and validate extraction proposals without financial writes, supplier matching, duplicate detection, real OCR/provider integration, QA/Production mutations, or deployment.
scope: First prove repository identity projectmanagmentnotion-CostaClean/costa-clean-app and exact baseline eb4b3708c0adc56f936b067460bdc42814d33751. If the execution worktree cannot be based on that exact commit, stop HUMAN_REQUIRED without edits.

Implement a versioned N5.3 normalization contract under src/features/expenses with NormalizationStatus, ValidationSeverity, stable ValidationIssue codes, NormalizedField and NormalizedExpenseProposal concepts.
Preserve the original N5.2 ExtractionProposal as immutable evidence. Never overwrite rawValue, extracted value, confidence, source or evidence; normalized values and validation issues are additive.
Implement pure deterministic provider-independent normalization with no network, Supabase, Date.now, randomness or environment-dependent behavior.

Implement exact decimal-string arithmetic without JavaScript floating-point accounting; include normalize/add/subtract/compare/absolute-difference helpers and explicit 0.01 reconciliation tolerance where justified.
Normalize unambiguous document decimal formats safely and mark ambiguous representations instead of inventing values.
Normalize currencies without defaulting EUR; explicit euro symbol may normalize to EUR, missing stays missing, unknown values require attention.
Normalize deterministic dates to YYYY-MM-DD, reject impossible dates, and mark day/month ambiguous forms rather than silently assuming locale.
Normalize invoice numbers conservatively: trim/collapse safe whitespace while preserving prefixes, suffixes, leading zeroes, slashes and meaningful hyphens.

Normalize and validate tax-id candidates separately from supplier identity; implement deterministic Spanish NIF/NIE/CIF checks while foreign/unknown formats remain non-matched candidates rather than being rejected as suppliers.
Implement document-type-aware validation for INVOICE, RECEIPT, CREDIT_NOTE, OTHER and UNKNOWN without inventing document type.
Implement VAT-line validation and multi-VAT reconciliation; support legitimate rates including 0/4/10/21 and other values without Spain-only universal hard-coding.
Support negative amounts and credit notes.
Implement reconciliation states MATCH, MISMATCH, INSUFFICIENT_DATA and COMPLEX_ADJUSTMENT, respecting discounts/withholding so totals are never silently rewritten.
Keep provider confidence separate from validation policy; high-confidence extracted data may still be inconsistent.
Derive review status READY_FOR_REVIEW, NEEDS_ATTENTION or BLOCKED; never CONFIRMED.
Add comprehensive focused tests for decimals, dates, currency, invoice number, tax IDs, VAT, multi-VAT, reconciliation, negatives/credit notes, confidence separation, immutability and determinism.
Create docs/N5_3_NORMALIZATION_VALIDATION.md documenting invariants, policies, known limits and the N5.4/N5.5 handoff.
Run focused N5.3 tests, all expense N5.1/N5.2/N5.3 tests, full tests, qa:agents, TypeScript, lint, build, secret scan and git diff --check.
Run an independent read-only review of the delta and require P0=P1=P2=P3=0 before considering local implementation complete.
Local commits in the isolated execution worktree are allowed if all local gates pass. Do not publish/push them without human approval.
outOfScope: Any QA or Production database mutation.
Any Supabase migration or Edge deployment.
Any GitHub push, pull request, merge or publication of application commits.
Real OCR/AI provider selection, billing, API keys or provider calls.
Supplier Master creation, canonical supplier matching, aliases or merge logic (N5.4).
Human confirmation transaction or expense creation (N5.5).
Expense, supplier, invoice, payment or ledger writes.
N5.4, N5.5 or Production release work.
acceptanceCriteria: Execution baseline is proven exactly eb4b3708c0adc56f936b067460bdc42814d33751 before edits.
N5.3 contract is versioned and provider-independent.
Input N5.2 proposal remains immutable and raw evidence is preserved.
No floating-point accounting is used for monetary reconciliation.
Ambiguous decimals and dates fail closed into review signals; no silent value invention or EUR default.
Invoice numbers preserve meaningful formatting and leading zeroes.
Spanish tax IDs are deterministically validated without leaking into supplier matching.
Multi-VAT and credit-note negatives are supported.
Reconciliation handles discounts/withholding without applying a false simple identity.
Provider confidence and validation state remain separate.
Review status is deterministic and never implies confirmation.
Focused and full tests, agents, TypeScript, lint, build, secret scan and diff check pass.
Independent review finds P0=0 P1=0 P2=0 P3=0.
No remote application publication occurs before human approval.
allowedAutonomy: Create/use isolated orchestrator worktree from the exact authorized baseline.
Local source and test edits strictly within N5.3 scope.
Run local tests, typecheck, lint, build, secret scan and diff checks.
Local commits inside the isolated execution worktree after verification.
Generate factual reports and local artifacts.
Retry safe local verification/repair within orchestrator bounded retry rules.
allowedActions: git status/diff/show/log and read-only Git inspection
edit files in isolated execution worktree
requiredApprovals: Any git push or publication of the resulting application commit.
Any Supabase QA or Production mutation, migration or Edge deployment.
Any destructive cleanup outside the isolated worktree.
stopConditions: Repository identity or baseline does not match exact eb4b3708c0adc56f936b067460bdc42814d33751.
Accepted Brain/control-plane integrity is stale or invalid.
Existing human checkout or unrelated worktree would be modified.
Scope requires N5.4, N5.5, real provider integration, remote services or Production.
Tests/build reveal an out-of-scope regression requiring broad refactor.
Independent review reports any unresolved P0/P1/P2/P3 finding.
A remote write, push, PR, merge, deploy, migration, secret or other approval-required action becomes the next step.
Orchestrator reaches its bounded retry/no-progress limit.
verificationRequirements: Prove exact start HEAD eb4b3708c0adc56f936b067460bdc42814d33751 and clean isolated worktree.
Final report states QA_MUTATIONS=0, DATABASE_CHANGES=0, MIGRATIONS=0, EDGE_DEPLOYS=0, PRODUCTION_MUTATIONS=0.
Final report identifies the next human gate explicitly.
